Note::unsqueeze¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::unsqueeze(std::int64_t dim) const

Insert A Size-1 Axis¶

unsqueeze(dim) returns a Note with a new axis of length 1 inserted at position dim, raising the rank by one. Reach for it to give a flat list a leading batch axis, to line two Notes up for a shape-sensitive operation, or to make a 1 × n row / n × 1 column out of a plain n.

Nothing about the text changes: cells are shared with the source, the bytes-vs-UTF-8 mode carries over, and only the shape metadata is rewritten. expand_dims(dim) is an exact synonym and this page covers both.

The dim contract¶

  • dim may be 0 .. dim() — inserting at dim() appends the new axis at the end. A negative dim counts from the back with room for the new axis (-1 inserts as the new last axis).

  • The result must stay within rank 3; inserting a fourth axis raises inserting an axis would exceed Note max rank 3.

  • An out-of-range dim raises dim out of range.

Example 1: A Leading Axis¶

const auto v = pluss::make_note({"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(v.unsqueeze(0)) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[1, 6], dim=2, numel=6, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]
]

Example 2: A Trailing Axis¶

const auto v = pluss::make_note({"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(v.unsqueeze(1)) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[6, 1], dim=2, numel=6, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["a"], 
  ["b"], 
  ["c"], 
  ["d"], 
  ["e"], 
  ["f"]
]

Example 3: A Negative Position¶

const auto v = pluss::make_note({"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(v.unsqueeze(-1)) << "\n";   // same as unsqueeze(1)

Output¶

Note(shape=[6, 1], dim=2, numel=6, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["a"], 
  ["b"], 
  ["c"], 
  ["d"], 
  ["e"], 
  ["f"]
]

Example 4: Scalar To Rank 1, And The Synonym¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(pluss::make_note("solo").unsqueeze(0)) << "\n";

const auto v = pluss::make_note({"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"});
std::cout << pluss::note::print(v.expand_dims(0)) << "\n";   // identical to unsqueeze(0)

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["solo"]
Note(shape=[1, 6], dim=2, numel=6, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"]
]

Example 5: Exceeding The Rank Limit¶

try {
  const auto t = pluss::make_note({{"a", "b"}}).reshape({1, 1, 2});   // rank 3
  (void)t.unsqueeze(0);
} catch (const pluss::Error& e) {
  const std::string m = e.what();
  std::cout << m.substr(0, m.find('\n')) << "\n";
}

Output¶

inserting an axis would exceed Note max rank 3

See Also¶

  • Note::squeeze: the inverse — remove a size-1 axis.

  • Note::reshape: restate the whole shape when more than one axis changes.
